notes.title: Wednesdays is out NOW on PC and Mac
notes.content:
Wednesdays is finally out on PC and Mac!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491000/38d7487d2d6bc2cb7dac5cbc2b6341dc2d076166.jpg

Whether you played the demo, wishlisted the game, or liked Wednesdays posts on social media, we thank you and hope you'll enjoy Tim's complete story. 

We appreciate every message we received about your experience with the demo, and we are looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the full game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GuxOOgSwcuE 

We hope you will feel all the love and care the amazing artists and devs poured into the game. And if you do, you can leave a Steam review to share your thoughts with the team!

If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to report them on the Steam Hub so we can ensure the best experience possible while playing Wednesdays.

Thanks to all future players! ːsteamhappyː
